title: Placement Training Test - Verbal Ability & Logical Reasoning
description: A focused placement-style assessment covering verbal ability, logical reasoning, critical thinking, and professional communication.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that best expresses the meaning of: "The proposal was rejected because it was not feasible."
options: The proposal was rejected because it was too expensive to implement.
The proposal was rejected because it was not practical to implement.
The proposal was rejected because nobody understood it.
The proposal was rejected because it was submitted late.

questions.question: The manager's explanation was so ___ that even a complex technical issue became easy to understand.
options: ambiguous
lucid
redundant
reluctant

questions.question: Read the statement: "All employees who completed the training received certificates. Maya did not receive a certificate." What can be logically concluded?
options: Maya definitely did not attend the training.
Maya definitely failed the training.
Maya did not complete the training.
Maya was absent from the company.

questions.question: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: No sooner the meeting started than the internet stopped working.
No sooner had the meeting started than the internet stopped working.
No sooner did the meeting started than the internet stopped working.
No sooner the meeting had started when the internet stopped working.

questions.question: Five presentations — P, Q, R, S and T — are scheduled one after another. P must be before R. S must be immediately before T. Which arrangement is possible?
options: R P S T Q
Q P R S T
S T R P Q
P S R T Q

questions.question: A company observes that teams using a documented checklist make fewer deployment errors than teams that do not use one. Which conclusion is best supported?
options: A checklist guarantees that no deployment errors will occur.
Using a checklist may help reduce deployment errors.
Teams without checklists cannot deploy software successfully.
Deployment errors are caused only by documentation.

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the analogy: "Blueprint : Building :: Algorithm : ?"
options: Database
Program
Keyboard
Network

questions.question: A, B, C and D each have a different role: Developer, Designer, Tester and Analyst. A is not the Developer or Tester. B is the Analyst. C is not the Designer. D is the Tester. What role does A have?
options: Developer
Designer
Tester
Analyst

questions.question: Choose the sentence with the most appropriate professional tone for an email.
options: Send me the report now because I need it.
I need the report immediately. Please don't delay.
Could you please share the updated report when convenient?
Why haven't you sent the report yet?

questions.question: A team has completed a project successfully, but the client requests one additional feature before the final release. What is the most logical first action?
options: Immediately implement the feature without discussion.
Reject the client's request because the project is already complete.
Understand the requirement, assess its impact, and then estimate the additional work.
Ask the client to find another team.
